mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MemberBall_pick (memberBall_num, pickBall_date, memberIdx, ball_idx) VALUES(memberBall_seq.NEXTVAL, TRUNC(SYSDATE), #{memberIdx}, #{ball_idx})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MemberBall_pick WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx} AND pickBall_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT b.ball_idx, b.ball_name, b.ball_image, b.ball_grade, COUNT(*) AS pickCount FROM MemberBall_pick mbp JOIN Ball b ON b.ball_idx = mbp.ball_idx WHERE mbp.memberIdx = #{memberIdx} GROUP BY b.ball_idx, b.ball_name, b.ball_image,b.ball_grade ORDER BY b.ball_idx
